text: {"name":"wlan_ba_reorder_lookup","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Selects the per-peer/TID Block Ack context and searches its buffered sequence list when the incoming 12-bit sequence is not behind the context sequence point.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v3":"sequence_control","v4":"context_sequence","v5":"sequence_delta_unsigned","v6":"sequence_delta"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":8,"meaning":"Block Ack context sequence point used for the sequence comparison"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Packed metadata whose high nibble selects the TID"},{"offset":18,"meaning":"Sequence control field; bits 4–15 contain the 12-bit sequence number"}]}
